claim: Ulysses S. Grant, commander of the Union Army during the American Civil War, was a slave owner.

sub_claims.question: Was Ulysses S. Grant the commander of the Union Army during the American Civil War?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Ulysses S. Grant was appointed General-in-Chief of the Union Army by President Abraham Lincoln in March 1864 and served in that role until the war ended.

evidence.statement: Ulysses S. Grant was appointed General-in-Chief of the Union Army by President Abraham Lincoln on March 9, 1864.

sub_claims.question: Did Ulysses S. Grant ever own slaves?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, historical records show that Ulysses S. Grant owned a slave named William Jones, whom he freed in 1859, before the Civil War.

evidence.statement: Ulysses S. Grant owned a slave named William Jones.
Ulysses S. Grant freed William Jones in 1859.
